description: This file is an HTML document that includes inline JavaScript code which creates and manipulates a tree structure representing zoo animals. It loads external JavaScript modules related to the Isomorphic SmartClient framework and initializes UI components such as a Tree and TreeGrid to display hierarchical data.

methods.name: Tree.create
methods.description: Creates a tree structure with specified ID and data, representing hierarchical zoo animal information.

methods.name: Tree.openFolder
methods.description: Expands a specific folder node within the tree based on its reference.

methods.name: Tree.find
methods.description: Finds a node within the tree data by its path string.

methods.name: TreeGrid.create
methods.description: Initializes a TreeGrid component to display the tree data in a UI grid.
